# RankSight AI

> An AI-powered SEO analysis tool that helps websites optimize for both traditional search engines and AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity

## About

RankSight AI is a comprehensive SEO analysis platform designed for the modern web. We analyze your website's performance across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search systems. Our tool evaluates content quality, technical SEO factors, and how well your site works with large language models.

We provide actionable, AI-generated recommendations to improve your rankings in both traditional search results and AI-generated answers. Whether you're optimizing for Google, preparing for AI citations, or ensuring your content meets E-E-A-T guidelines, RankSight AI gives you the insights you need.

## Key Features

- [SEO Analysis](https://ranksightai.com/features): Comprehensive website audits covering technical SEO, content quality, and performance metrics
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://ranksightai.com/features): Evaluate how well your content works with AI models like ChatGPT and Claude
- [E-E-A-T Evaluation](https://ranksightai.com/features): Measure your content's Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness
- [Keyword Analysis](https://ranksightai.com/features): Discover optimization opportunities and keyword density insights
- [Duplicate Content Detection](https://ranksightai.com/features): Identify and resolve content duplication issues
- [Real-time Monitoring](https://ranksightai.com/features): Track your SEO performance over time with comprehensive dashboards
